SELECT * FROM ( SELECT /*selectMasterMpRqSellerChoicePopList*/ /*+ RULE*/ S.COM_CODE AS AGENT, S.COM_NAME_LOC ||'('||S.COM_CODE||')' AS AGENT_NAME, (SELECT ITMG1_NM FROM SUPLITMG WHERE SUPPLIER=S.COM_CODE) AS ITMG1_NM, S.ZIP_CODE, (SELECT MAX(SIDO||' '||GUGUN) FROM ICOMZIPC WHERE ZIPCODE = S.ZIP_CODE) AS AREA, (SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.KEP_BUYER1 AND STATUS <> 'D')||' '|| (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.KEP_BUYER2 AND STATUS <> 'D')||' '|| (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.KEP_BUYER3 AND STATUS <> 'D')||' '|| (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.KEP_BUYER4 AND STATUS <> 'D') FROM SUPLITMG A WHERE SUPPLIER=S.COM_CODE) AS MAJOR_COM, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE AGENT=S.COM_CODE AND ADD_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-90,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) AS TCNT, NVL((SELECT SUM(PO_TTL_AMT) FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE AGENT=S.COM_CODE AND ADD_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-90,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')),0) AS TAMT
, NVL((SELECT NVL(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0) FROM KEPQTDT A WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer_code} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND A.STATUS='C' AND A.AGENT=S.COM_CODE),0) AS ATOB_UNIT_PRICE , NVL((SELECT NVL(A.STOA_LIST_PRICE,0) FROM KEPQTDT A WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer_code} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND A.STATUS='C' AND A.AGENT=S.COM_CODE),0) AS STOA_LIST_PRICE , (SELECT STOA_REMARK FROM KEPQTDT A WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer_code} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND A.STATUS='C' AND A.AGENT=S.COM_CODE) AS STOA_REMARK , f_get_dss_chk(#{st_buyer_code},S.COM_CODE,0) AS DSS_YN , f_get_dss_chk(#{st_buyer_code},S.COM_CODE,1) AS DSS_MSG , NVL((SELECT MIN(STOA_LIST_PRICE) FROM KEPQTDT A WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer_code} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND A.STATUS='C' AND NVL(STOA_LIST_PRICE,0) <> 0),0) AS MIN_PRICE , (SELECT NVL(A.DSS_CHOICE ,A.DSS_FLAG) FROM KEPQTDT A WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer_code} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND A.STATUS='C' AND A.STATUS <> 'O' AND A.AGENT = S.COM_CODE) AS DSS_CHOICE
FROM ICOMCMPY S WHERE S.BUSINESS_COND='S' AND S.STATUS IN('C','R')
AND S.COM_CODE IN
#{item}
AND S.COM_CODE IN (SELECT AGENT FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer_code} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND B.BUYER=A.BUYER AND B.QUOTATION_NO=A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ=A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND B.REVISION=A.REVISION AND B.STATUS <> 'O' AND A.RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND A.STATUS <> 'D' )
) TOT ORDER BY DECODE(NVL(TOT.STOA_LIST_PRICE,0), 0, 999999999999,TOT.STOA_LIST_PRICE) ASC

/*selectMasterMpRqSellerChoiceRemarkPopList*/ SELECT A.ATOS_REMARK, (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*), 0, 'Y', 'N') FROM KEP_NEGO_ITEM_MD_REQ WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REVISION = A.REVISION AND ITEM_MD_STATUS = 'C' AND ITEM_MD_USER_ID IS NULL) AS NEGO_ITEM_MD_COMPLETE, A.IMAGE_KEY, A.SELLER_IMAGE_KEY, A.IMAGE_PASS_FLAG FROM KEPRQDT A WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND A.RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND A.STATUS <> 'D'

SELECT /*selectChkFlag*/ CASE WHEN QTDT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE CASE WHEN BID_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END END CHK_FLAG FROM ( SELECT MIN(QTDT_CLOSE_FLAG) AS QTDT_CLOSE_FLAG, MIN(BID_FLAG) AS BID_FLAG FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN SYSDATE >= TO_DATE(A.ATOS_END_DATE||A.ATOS_END_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END QTDT_CLOSE_FLAG, CASE WHEN A.STOA_DATE IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END BID_FLAG FROM KEPQTDT A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND A.QUOTATION_NO = #{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ = #{st_quotation_seq} AND A.REVISION = #{st_revision} AND A.AGENT_REVISION = #{PRE_AGENT_REVISION} ) A1 ) A2
